name: Logan Energy Corp.
summary: Logan Energy Corp. engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas properties. The company holds interest in the Simonette and Pouce Coupe properties in northwest Alberta; and the Flatrock property in northeastern British Columbia. Logan Energy Corp. was formerly known as 2499938 Alberta Ltd. and changed its name to Logan Energy Corp. in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
